rules.name: Murderous Imperative
rules.legend: The Skitarii fighting in a focused clade all but vibrate with the inloaded need to kill. This manifests not as wild rage, however, but rather as a coldly efficient drive to acquire the next target, bring it down with pinpoint fire or neatly placed thrusts, then find a new victim and repeat in an infinite loop.
rules.description_html:
Each time a model in a Skitarii unit from your army makes an attack:
  • If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
  • If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
rules.description_text:
Each time a model in a Skitarii unit from your army makes an attack:
If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: PRECISION ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Leading the charge like a keen bayonet locked to a rifle’s barrel, maniples of Sicarians scythe into the enemy amidst a welter of blood and severed limbs
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a Sicarian unit from your army declares a charge.

TARGET: That SICARIAN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.description_text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a Sicarian unit from your army declares a charge.

TARGET: That SICARIAN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: UNRELENTING AGGRESSION
stratagems.legend: Even when retreating temporarily in the face of staunch resistance, the warriors of the Omnissiah keep up their storm of fire and violent blows.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the Skitarii keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.
stratagems.description_text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the Skitarii keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

stratagems.name: ANALYTIC REPRISALS
stratagems.legend: Rapid threat analysis triggers the Skitarii to return fire against foes deemed immediate threats, surprising the enemy and thinning their lines
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One Skitarii Infantry unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: THREAT‑COGITATION TARGETERS
stratagems.legend:
Supplementary analytic cogitation routines identify targets of primary importance and assist in their
rapid elimination.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Skitarii Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.
stratagems.description_text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Skitarii Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

stratagems.name: UNSHACKLED WRATH
stratagems.legend: With Binharic prayers of disengagement, these warriors release the saviour protocols of their weapon spirits to release the guns’ full wrath.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Skitarii unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: SERVO‑DRIVEN CHARGE
stratagems.legend: Sending reckless surges of motive force through their units, these warriors charge headlong into combat with punishing impact.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

enhancements.name: Omnicogitator
enhancements.legend: This unique tactical-cogitation augmetic provides its bearer with a wealth of situation-appropriate responses in even the most intense battle.
enhancements.description_html: Skitarii Marshal model only. The Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.description_text: Skitarii Marshal model only. The Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Martial Signatum Amplificator
enhancements.legend: This strange device taps into the data-tethers that carry Skitarii command imperatives and disseminates them to other, less soldierly servants of the Omnissiah.
enhancements.description_html: Tech-Priest model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Skitarii keyword.
enhancements.description_text: Tech-Priest model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Skitarii keyword.

enhancements.name: Belicosa-Class Capacitor Vanes
enhancements.legend: These slender conductor vanes channel esoteric energies into nearby weapon systems, rendering their machine spirits rapacious and bellicose.
enhancements.description_html: Adeptus Mechanicus model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit, and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of those weapons.
enhancements.description_text: Adeptus Mechanicus model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit, and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of those weapons.

enhancements.name: Omnissiah’s Fury
enhancements.legend: A Skitarii Marshal implanted with this thoracic augmetic feels the Machine God’s molten fury flowing through their veins and out into the weapons they wield in battle.
enhancements.description_html: Skitarii Marshal model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.
